props.name: children
props.comment: Replaces the whole row of default buttons.

props.name: exporter
props.comment: Runs on export; `false` hides the export button.

props.name: filters
props.comment: Filter inputs for the filter button. Defaults to the ambient `FilterContext`.

props.name: hasCreate
props.comment: Show the create button. Defaults to the resource's `hasCreate`.
